To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
plasma renin activity was inversely related to blood pressure level in patients with essential hypeension.

the blood pressure level must be taken into account in order to interpret the plasma renin activity, and that the pressure-renin activity index, which is defined as the product of the blood pressure level and the logarithm of the plasma renin level, is useful for evaluating the plasma renin status in patients with hypertension.

the correlation between the analogue response and renin activity (pressure-renin relationship) is highly significant and the regression lines for the hypertensive and the normotensive groups do not differ.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of plasma renin in patients with hypertension.
a new index for plasma renin activity which takes into account blood pressure.
the evaluation of plasma renin levels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the blood pressure level and plasma renin activity should be evaluated together when assessing the pathophysiological role of the renin-angiotensin system.
the blood pressure level must be taken into account in evaluating the renin system in patients with hypertension.
the pressure-renin concept is valid for both hypertensive and normotensive subjects.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the pressure-renin relationship is not changed in hypertensive patients.
plasma renin activity should be evaluated by a pressure-renin index, which is a product of the mean blood pressure level and plasma renin activity.
the pressure-renin relationship is a more accurate indicator of the functional state of the renin-angiotensin system than the plasma renin activity itself.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the blood pressure level must be taken into account for the evaluation of plasma renin.
the renin-angiotensin system is a key player in the development of hypertension.
renin activity is a good predictor of blood pressure.
